title: Holistic memory orchestrator for variable dialogue streams
creator: Ava Patel
description: We need an end-to-end orchestration layer that tunes continuous batching behavior and KV residency together for workloads with high variance in prompt and response lengths. Current scheduler heuristics cause repeated KV thrashing and uneven GPU slab fragmentation when a mix of short prompts (<=16 tokens) and very long completions (>1024 tokens) are interleaved. This ticket designs, implements, and validates a 'Holistic Memory Orchestrator' that coordinates: 1) admission prioritization; 2) adaptive slot tenure; 3) KV compaction profiles; 4) length-aware coalescing windows. Goal: reduce p95 token generation latency regressions and GPU memory spikes while keeping throughput within 5% of baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by runtime and infra leads
Implementation merged behind feature flag and unit/integration tests present
Bench harness shows p95 token latency reduction >= 20% for mixed-turn benchmark vs current main branch under 75% load
GPU memory high-water mark reduced by >= 18% during simulated skewed-dialogue traffic
No >2% drop in throughput (tokens/sec) on homogeneous long-turn workloads
Rollout plan and safe fallback (auto-disable on memory regression) documented
notes: Root cause: short-turns get coalesced aggressively which pins KV for short tenure; long-turns allocate large KV slabs that force eviction of useful prefixes for upcoming long continuations.
Hypothesis: coupling slot tenure to expected response-length distribution (per-cohort pacing) and introducing a lightweight KV compact-on-evict profile will smooth residency and reduce fragmentation.
We will use cohort fingerprinting (hash of prompt template + model variant) to estimate expected continuation length percentile from recent telemetry.
Will instrument new metrics: cohort_kv_residency_seconds, slot_age_histogram, kv_compaction_passes, compaction_pauses_ms, and admission_rejects_by_cohort.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Read-only telemetry ingestion - add cohort length estimator and slot_age metrics (2d)
Phase 2: Admission tiering - prioritize long-turn reservations with async slot reservation tokens and short-turn fast-path (3d)
Phase 3: Adaptive slot tenure - extend tenure for predicted long-turn cohorts and shorten for pure short-turn cohorts (4d)
Phase 4: KV compact profiles - implement aggressive compaction on reclaimed slabs for mixed cohorts (3d)
Phase 5: E2E bench and canary rollout behind feature flag (2d)
Phase 6: Rollout with gradual ramp and automatic rollback on memory/p95 triggers (1d)
benchmarks: Baseline test: mixlen-synthetic-75pct-load (50% short prompts 16t avg, 50% long completions 1200t avg)
Preliminary perf target: p95_token_latency baseline 120ms -> target <=96ms on mixed benchmark
Memory target: hwm baseline 42.7GiB -> target <=35GiB under same workload
